# Vchemics India Solutions
> Manufacturer and supplier of construction chemicals, precision grouts, crystalline waterproofing systems and structural repair products across Tamil Nadu, with hubs in Chennai, Coimbatore, Erode and Krishnagiri.

Vchemics India Solutions brings 15+ years of experience supplying IS, ASTM and EN standard construction chemical formulations, with technical site support for infrastructure, commercial and residential projects throughout South India.

## Products

- [Concrete Admixtures & Chemical Additives](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/concrete-admixtures): High-performance polycarboxylate ether (PCE) and SNF chemical admixtures engineered for high slump retention, up to 30% water cut, and rapid early strength development.
- [Waterproofing Chemicals](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/waterproofing-chemicals): Integral crystalline powders, hydrophobic pore-blocking liquids, and acrylic elastomeric barrier chemicals delivering permanent protection against hydrostatic pressure.
- [PU Injection Grouting](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/pu-injection-grouting): Rapidly expanding single & dual component hydrophobic polyurethane injection resins that react violently with ingress water to form a closed-cell elastomeric barrier.
- [Non-Shrink Grout](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/non-shrink-grout): Factory-blended, shrinkage-compensated cementitious grouts engineered with selected spherical aggregates and reactive expanders for ultimate load transfer.
- [Epoxy Grouting](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/epoxy-grouting): Ultra-high strength 3-part epoxy grouts offering extraordinary compressive, tensile, and shear strengths with total resistance to chemical spills and extreme dynamic shock.
- [Protective Coatings](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/protective-coatings): Weather-resistant aliphatic PU topcoats, high-build solvent-free epoxy floorings, and breathable anti-carbonation coatings engineered to shield concrete against UV and weathering.
- [Concrete Repair](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/concrete-repair): Thixotropic polymer-modified structural repair mortars, zinc-rich rebar anti-corrosion primers, and epoxy bonding agents for precision concrete restoration.
- [Micro Concrete](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/products/micro-concrete): Pre-bagged, single component, polymer-modified micro concrete designed for structural encasement, heavy section repair, and column enlargement without vibration.

## Solutions

- [Basement Waterproofing Chemicals & Sealants](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/basement-waterproofing): Permanent deep-pore crystalline & membrane envelope against hydrostatic head
- [Terrace Waterproofing](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/terrace-waterproofing): Seamless elastomeric PU & acrylic coatings resistant to thermal expansion & ponding
- [Concrete Repair](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/concrete-repair): Diagnostic restoration of spalled concrete, rebar corrosion & structural cracks
- [Structural Rehabilitation](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/structural-rehabilitation): Engineered section enlargement, micro concrete encasements & load recovery
- [Industrial Flooring](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/industrial-flooring): Heavy-duty monolithic metallic floor hardeners, epoxy & polyurethane screeds
- [Protective & Architectural Painting](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/solutions/painting): Industrial protective coatings and architectural finishes for lasting performance and appearance.

## Technical Guides

- [PU Injection Grouting: Process, Uses, Types & Selection Guide](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/pu-injection-grouting): Learn how PU injection grouting seals concrete leaks and cracks, its types, process, applications, limitations and selection factors.
- [How to Prevent Cold Joints in High-Temperature Concrete Pours](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/preventing-cold-joints-tropical-concrete): In South India's high ambient heat, standard hydration accelerates rapidly.
- [Crystalline vs Elastomeric Membrane Waterproofing: Engineering Selection Guide](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/crystalline-vs-membrane-waterproofing): Deep dive into chemical crystallization vs liquid polyurethane elastomeric membranes: comparative pore sealing chemistry, hydrostatic head resistance, and crack self-healing capabilities.
- [Precision Grouting for Heavy Equipment: Chemical Solutions & Installation Guide](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/precision-grouting-heavy-equipment-guide): Comprehensive guide to precision grouting for heavy machinery, covering epoxy, PU, and polyester chemical solutions, and step-by-step installation procedures.
- [High-Pressure PU Injection Grouting for Active Hydrostatic Water Ingress](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/pu-injection-active-leak-sealing): Step-by-step 45-degree mechanical packer installation and hydro-active polyurethane resin injection at 50–250 bar to permanently arrest high-pressure gushing leaks.
- [Structural Column Jacketing & Section Enlargement with Micro Concrete](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/column-jacketing-micro-concrete-standards): Best practices for RCC column encasement, rebar passivating primers, shear dowel anchorage, and self-compacting micro concrete placement compliant with EN 1504-3 Class R4.
- [Waterproofing Chemicals: A Simple Guide for Better Building Protection](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/waterproofing-chemicals-guide): Learn how waterproofing chemicals control moisture, where to apply them, and how to select the right protection for walls, terraces, basements, wet areas, and water tanks.
- [Protective Coatings: Types, Benefits & Uses](https://www.vchemicsindia.com/blog/protective-coatings-for-buildings): Learn about protective coatings, their types, benefits, applications, and selection for concrete, steel, roofs, and industrial surfaces.
